# A hugo baseURL pointing at localhost never serves the built site.
# ruleid: localhost-base-url
baseURL = "http://localhost:1313/"
# ruleid: localhost-base-url
baseURL = "http://127.0.0.1:1313/"
# ok: localhost-base-url
baseURL = "https://example.com/"
# ok: localhost-base-url
server = "localhost"
